prompt:
Create a premium game concept comparison sheet for Brazilian game 1500, REGION MAP SCREEN. Two large horizontal 16:9 gameplay map mockups stacked vertically in a portrait sheet, 1536x2048 or similar. The two options are labeled A "Mapa ilustrado" and B "Relevo em miniatura". This is clearly a "Proposta visual · região fictícia · valores ilustrativos", bottom small note. Inspired by polished strategy regional maps, original composition. Identity of game is vivid Brazilian coastal Atlantic forest before 1500, deep green rainforest, turquoise winding river, orange warm earth, golden sunlight. Architecture ONLY tiny triangular green palm-leaf-roof huts around small village campfire. UI forest green translucent panels, cream readable Portuguese text, thin fine amber borders, terracotta selected button. Avoid medieval castles, European parchment, fantasy runes, ethnic ornamental motifs, hex grids, roads with cobblestones, city blocks, zoomed-in town gameplay.
Each image is a map of the surrounding fictional LOCAL region, not whole Brazil and not real geography. Single compact unified TOP bar showing wood 120 stone80 fibers80 food60, people2/2 and day/time "Dia 1 · 16:00" plus pause and "1× 2× 3×", all in one row full width. Screen title discreet "Mapa regional" top left below HUD. A bottom center button "Voltar à aldeia". Within map, a small home marker "Aldeia", near "Arredores", adjacent "Margem do rio". These three regions visible and connected with very subtle dotted travel paths. More distant areas under thick soft charcoal-green fog, labeled only "Desconhecido", hiding geography, resources and animals. Do not show full river or map features under fog. No visible danger level of unknown regions. Accessible local river region selected with warm amber small ring and leaf+fish resource icons. Short right-hand info card "Margem do rio", "Conhecida", "Viagem · 1 min", "Recursos · Peixes e fibras", "Abundância · Alta", "Perigo · Baixo", "Animais · Sem registros". No "send expedition", exploration controls, research buttons or combat. This screen is information only for stage6. No tiny text or dense decorative icons, ample scenic map space.
Option A: beautiful stylized 2D painted aerial CARTOGRAPHY, flat top-down view, lush painted distinct canopies, winding river, elegant hand painted terrain texture, irregular softly outlined region boundaries, crisp labels. Original professional game map with inviting Brazilian tropical character. NOT parchment brown map.
Option B: same exact regions and known/unknown scheme, rendered isometric small TERRAIN DIORAMA seen obliquely, softly faceted lush 3D canopy clumps, ridges, stream, little native village. 2.5D relief, map-scale rather than street-level. Make A and B genuinely different camera/medium yet matching palette and UI. No floating island cube edges. Keep all Portuguese words legible and accurately spelled. Surround proposal sheet simple dark green margin, clean large A and B headings; no logos or invented slogans. Both fit the same approved full-width unified HUD and bottom-centered navigation.

opcoes.A: Cartografia ilustrada 2D, regiões interativas no Godot
opcoes.B: Relevo em miniatura, terreno no Blender e integração Godot

nota: A barra do conceito é simplificada. A implementação usará os oito recursos da barra existente.
